subject: UI Does Not Load any Output, Only Input

messages.author: 01289d5ce650d88c
messages.subject: UI Does Not Load any Output, Only Input
parts:
Hello All, 

I have stumbled upon an issue where the UI (google Chrome) would load only the widgets, but no tables/results are outputed. Almost immediately, the UI screen would turn dark and reactivity would stop. The R-studio in the meantime would still listen to the port.  Although the UI would quit working almost immediately, the variables and results are loaded in the R-Studio. I am not sure why the UI would stop working with the server. It has worked flawlessly in the past. 

If this question has been asked before, please accept my apologies. I have tried to search for a solution but have not yet found the right one. 

Thanks, 

Dan
